name: modo
description: A clear identity for a small-business finance tool. Interlocking modules and a single decisive cobalt accent create a system that feels both trustworthy and approachable.
heading: manrope
rules: Keep a one-module gap between the two halves of the symbol.
Use cobalt for active elements, with ledger for long-form text.
Align numerical values to the right and use consistent decimal precision.

system.concept: Folded modular M geometry, confident cobalt interfaces, and meticulous financial hierarchy. The expressive graphic system never obscures numerical information.
headline: A little more clarity.
A lot more possibility.
system.eyebrow: A BETTER VIEW OF YOUR BUSINESS
features: A considered hierarchy that makes important information clear.
Useful workflows that keep the everyday details together.
A trustworthy foundation for the next part of your business.
system.layoutNote: White finance hero with cobalt modular illustration. Ledger text for long reading, aligned numeric rows, and calm 10px card corners. Avoid decorative low-contrast data.
